CHAOS-9676: in oracle_cases.json the case impact_summary/manyScopes holds the Go resolver's answer for aiAssistedPrs and aiAssistedPrRatio, not the Python resolver's. The Python resolvers were deleted (#2794) and their summary added the stored group-wide ai_assisted_prs column over every bucket row, which counts a group once per emitted bucket row; the summary now takes each count from its own bucket's prs_total (aiAssistedPrs 11 -> 90 and aiAssistedPrRatio 0.0759 -> 0.6207 on this synthetic fixture, whose stored ai_assisted_prs column is not the bucket's pull-request count). Every other value in the file is unchanged. The change was written by the script recorded in the PR (the case's Go answer, field by field), not typed.
